data.name: Wadooah Wali
data.role: Co-Founder & Executive Producer - New Canvas  // Producer - Artizen LIVE
data.bio: Wadooah Wali (she/her) is Co-Founder & Chief Publishing & Strategy Officer and EP at New Canvas, an award-winning immersive studio, recently honored with the XR Women Trailblazer Award at AWE USA 2026. At New Canvas, she pioneered the Elliot Page and PAGEBOY Productions partnership on When Brooklyn Was Queer. She also produces Artizen LIVE, a weekly creator showcase and brings 20+ years of strategic, media experience from WarnerMedia, Fullscreen and Demand Media and currently serves on the GALECA: the Society of LGBTQ+ Entertainment Critics Advisory board and will judge the  upcoming 31st Annual Webby Awards as a newly inducted member of the International Academy of Digital Arts & Sciences.

data.name: Ramona Tudorancea
data.bio: Ramona comes from a legal background of international corporate and finance, investment funds and M&A, and brings legal strategy and multi-jurisdictional structuring to a new level, with a focus on the Law of the Network State, the evolution of organizations and RWAs tokenization. She is also a Graduate (GradCG) of the Chartered Governance Institute UK and Ireland.
data.sessionDescription:
Decentralized Futures explores how decentralized technologies are evolving beyond financial protocols into new infrastructure for coordination, governance, ownership, and institution-building. Drawing from legal engineering, Web3, Network State, and emerging models of digital organization, Ramona Tudorancea examines what it takes to turn decentralization from an ideology into durable real-world systems.

Beyond DeFi: Explore how decentralized infrastructure can reshape organizations, communities, governance, and economic coordination.
From Protocols to Institutions: Examine how code, law, governance, and incentives can work together.
New Models of Ownership & Participation: Consider emerging approaches to contribution, digital property, community capital, and shared value creation.
Designing Decentralized Futures: Investigate the opportunities and challenges of building systems that preserve individual agency while remaining legally resilient, economically viable, and capable of operating in the real world.

data.name: Diana Ilieva
data.bio: Diana is a tokenomics consultant at FinDaS Ltd with over 5 years of experience in creating data-driven token economy models for various crypto projects. Diana has created the tokenomics for P2E projects, stablecoins, lending & DeFi protocols, RWA and consulted on narrow topics like DAO structures and processes.
data.sessionDescription: This sessions views tokens not as investment, but as purpose-built economic tools and financial instruments. We'll discuss issuance, value drivers, release schedules and when a token has strong fundamentals.

data.name: Esther Wong
data.bio: Esther Wong is the Founder and CEO of Cashi, a global spending card built to make digital dollars simple, usable and borderless. Before founding Cashi, she spent seven years at Crypto.com, where she helped build and scale its card program into one of the largest in the industry. With deep experience across cards, payments and consumer financial products, Esther is focused on making global money easier to hold, send and spend for everyday users.
data.sessionDescription: Stablecoin Confidence is a practical masterclass designed to make stablecoins feel simple, useful and approachable. Esther will break down what stablecoins are, why they matter for people earning, saving and spending globally, and how to use them with more confidence in everyday life.
